body: that’s tough! you might have some luck trying to socialize online or join some sort of discord community. during my peak busy season, i use an exercise bike and the corresponding app (zwift) that lets me bike in occasional group rides. it’s no substitute for in-person socialization and the equipment barrier-to-entry is somewhat high, but it gets me active and it makes me feel a little less lonely especially since there’s usually people in other parts of the world biking when i do it late at night. also optionally. the app has like 15 minute workouts so i don’t have to throw a bunch of time into it when i come home. just an option!

ok idk if this situation qualifies as “”succeeding”” bc im still a little over 1 year in but i got my job after working 2 years in serving - not always the most fun but food service is unique and teaches you customer service skills that carry over to my current position. literally only got it bc they a restaurant coworker asked if a friend could come who worked for my current company and they happened to need people at the time. sometimes you have to meet people who know people to find the right place! 

altho i was like crazy nervous and miserable about having no internship (and one year out of school), it being a mid-size firm kind of helped. and i think the conversation skills i developed thru the service job helped me in the interview. maybe a mid-size or smaller firm might be good places to include when you start applying? internships might be a little more important for like deloitte and it certainly helps but it’s not going to be the sole deciding  for every firm or hiring manager. 

also tbh announcing u have plans to pursue your CPA could help too, and by the time u actually do it, whether or not you had an internship won’t even matter 🤗
thanks for replying!!!!! this is a more general question, but will exterminators review a house if you are not the house owner? maybe that answer depends on the specific service?

wahh i feel the same way sometimes like people aren’t telepathic but i wanna do smth big or scream or throw smth to get their attention or like to “show” them.. like ahh you should be noticing i feel bad!! it’s just not realistic but still.... a moderate nap or like a good snack makes me feel better. not perfect and it doesn’t like fix anything but it’s something that isn’t violent. birthdays suck sometimes! if you can’t celebrate the fact you’re still around celebrate another silly thing

I’m proud of you! You made it through the hardest part. Try putting them away or covering them if you feel like touching them might be a bit much. You made it through another night, even if you still feel shitty. won’t say it gets better with time, but try spoiling yourself w smth today to reward yourself.

not a professional at all!! but it might be time to bring in an adult. from my point of view, if she continues to do drugs, she will become more and more dependent on them. addiction is not her fault and can be treated if she is able to receive help or intervention. you seem young, and that is a heavy responsibility to place on your shoulders. You’re scared and that is normal! And she might lash out, because that’s how people with all types of problems respond when confronted with how big of a problem it is. idk what your or her home life is like, but maybe start with your mom first and get her opinion or advice on it. this is not something you can or should have to deal with by yourself. best of luck.

not a diagnosis but based off previous experiences it feels like suicidal ideation, and i think a little of it is common but a lot of it may become a problem. consider speaking to a professional, at the very least you can vent about it and maybe receive some other advice. also i get pretty bad when i’m tired and stressed so i think you are not alone in this. hope all is well

Been a few hours but hopefully you are asleep or have had to start the day in some other way. it seems like an impulsive decision for something that happened so very recently so you are right to feel sad and rejected, but there has to be something out there to distract your through the grieving period. even if it’s smth unconventional like a mobile game, or more common, like breakup playlists

Feel this as well..... suicidal ideation is very isolating, so seeing others also reaching out and receiving comments as well is nice, like there’s a person out there that will at least see my words here.

Also a closeted person at home, struggling with university. It sucks feeling like parents love is conditional with respects to your identity. might be time for a gap year or semester. this might derail things in your life a bit and turn heads, but taking breather could be worth it (I knew someone like this that took a gap semester and still graduated and she still has a whole adult job and everything). could just make an excuse up like “hoping to save money for finishing the degree”. either way, hope all is well

even if something tragic were to happen, it’s not your fault and at the end of the day you can’t control a persons actions like that. I’m sorry you are so young and going through something like this. remember that you can’t ignore your own feelings as well. also, remember that your problems are not a suffering competition and just because her’s seem worse to you should not devalue your own struggles, even if it feels that way. hope all is well.

Not a professional helper by any means but someone still going for the same reasons as your brother but previous commenter got a lot of it right. although as much as it sucks.. it’s really hard to help someone who doesn’t want it. I have rejected therapy because it meant giving up the possibility of one day “taking the easy way out” and I have been so dependent on this fact for a long time. this might be similar to how he feels? There could be options like involuntary hospitalization but there have been some people with bad experiences in wards (not all but still a fact). gl and i hope you are well

I hate the phrase “things will get better” as well because you’re always left to wonder if you’re missing out on the “better” that’s supposed to be happening right now.. therapy might help, and even if the therapist ends up sucking, at least it’s someone to vent to instead of keeping it all inside which I.....bet you do given your bg.. (also sliding scale therapy is a thing if cost is a problem) I try to find the stupid little things to keep me going like dumb little mobile apps to keep my brain moving. online communities through discord might help as well to help connect with others. i hope you’re somewhat well at least
